Identify the Hearts & Flowers form of each run

hf_forms.Rd

H&F v2 (core-tasks #442, shipped 2026-04-21) adds response windows and feedback, gated on a variant parameter that isn't exported to Redivis. A variant is v2 if any of its runs has more than 32 mixed-block trials (v1 has 32, v2 48) or its first run is on or after v2_start, since every variant created from 2026-04-23 on runs v2. (On the four pilot datasets as of 2026-11 the two signals agree on every variant.)

Usage

hf_forms(runs, trials, v2_start = "2026-04-23")

Arguments

runs

run data with columns run_id, task_id, variant_id, time_started

trials

trial data with columns run_id, item_task, item_group

v2_start

first date of v2 variants

Value

tibble with columns run_id and hf_form ("v1" or "v2"), one row per H&F run
